body:
MAINLINE-009d both points checked: all 84 numeric comparisons reproduce under the stated formulas. Payload 244.472107509 kg. Aramid least SF 0.650411843681, crimp; aluminium 0.617044785527, global, with both cell sizes tied. Independent mass-fraction search reproduces the aluminium grid optimum and the 0.668649769509 ceiling check.

Global-only aluminium kd=0.324125581629 reproduces. No kd alone makes every mode reach 1: wrinkling stays 0.617061966145 and face compression 0.771940448045.

Known upstream modelling NFI: dimpling is explicitly uniaxial. NASA eq 2.1-6 gives equal-biaxial factors 9.747456867816 and 4.332203052363, half the filed values; neither governs. The omitted aramid dimpling mode is 26.343099000191 equal-biaxial and also does not govern.

The separate 018 curve carry reproduces. At held geometries optimistic/conservative least SFs are aramid 0.650412/0.130082 and aluminium 0.617062/0.617045. Ranking depends on the curve. Source/packaging gaps and inherited assumptions are in NFI. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION; no certification.

This and rpt-ref-62323cf6831eb964377f complete the two-part check order. Proceeding to the queued MAINLINE-009e check.
